name: New Relic
title: New Relic: 32-bit Windows binaries for Infrastructure Agent removed
summary: As of Infrastructure Agent version 1.71.2 (released December 4, 2025), New Relic has discontinued the creation of 32-bit Windows binaries for the Infrastructure Agent and Native On-Host Integrations
replacement: All releases from version 1.71.2 onward only support x64 Windows binaries.

name: New Relic
title: New Relic: Legacy (pre-2020) Kubernetes container images removed
summary: The following images will be permanently removed on March 12, 2026: newrelic/k8s-nri-mongodb newrelic/k8s-nri-kafka newrelic/k8s-nri-couchbase newrelic/k8s-nri-rabbitmq newrelic/k8s-nri-nginx newrelic/k8s-nri-jmx newrelic/k8s-nri-cassandra newrelic/nri-statsd-alpha newrelic/k8s-webhook
replacement: New Relic Infrastructure Bundle (nri-bundle) Helm chart

name: New Relic
symbol: Node.js 20 runtime support in New Relic Node.js Agent
title: New Relic: Node.js 20 runtime support in New Relic Node.js Agent removed
summary: the Node.js 20 runtime reached its official End-of-Life effective 4/30/2026
replacement: Upgrade to Node.js 22 or newer, then upgrade to New Relic Node.js Agent v14.0.0 or newer

name: New Relic
symbol: New scripted monitors default to LATEST runtime
title: New Relic: New scripted monitors default to LATEST runtime (new default)
summary: Effective May 18, 2026, all scripted monitors that are going to be created either by UI, NerdGraph API or Terraform will be created on the LATEST runtime environment by default

name: New Relic
title: New Relic: Chrome 134 synthetic browser runtime removed
summary: Until Aug 18, 2026, existing monitors on Chrome 134 will still be supported. On Aug 18, 2026, all monitors will be force upgraded to the latest stable version (Chrome 147 or higher
replacement: Latest stable version (Chrome 147 or higher), which moves monitors to Node.js 22

name: New Relic
symbol: Kubernetes versions older than the three most recent minor versions
title: New Relic: Kubernetes versions older than the three most recent minor versions removed
summary: Effective Monday, October 19, 2026, our Kubernetes integration will support only the three most recent minor versions of Kubernetes
replacement: Upgrade Kubernetes clusters to a supported version

name: New Relic
title: New Relic: CodeStream In-IDE extension removed
summary: the CodeStream In-IDE extension will reach its End-of-Life (EOL) effective November 5, 2026
replacement: Agentic integrations and the New Relic AI MCP Server; browser interface for data access

name: New Relic
symbol: CodeStream API endpoints and cloud components
title: New Relic: CodeStream API endpoints and cloud components removed
summary: Effective November 5, 2026, the CodeStream extensions will be removed from all IDE marketplaces, along with associated cloud-based components and API endpoints
replacement: Agentic integrations and the New Relic AI MCP Server; browser interface for data access

name: New Relic
title: New Relic: Node.js 16 synthetic API runtime removed
summary: Until Nov 18, 2026, existing monitors on Node.js 16 will still be supported. On Nov 18, 2026, all monitors will be force upgraded to Node.js 22

name: New Relic
symbol: New Relic REST API v2 endpoints
title: New Relic: New Relic REST API v2 endpoints removed
summary: Effective July 31, 2027, the New Relic REST API v2 (excluding some Alerts endpoints) and the Deployments v0 API will reach end of life (EOL
replacement: NerdGraph, New Relic's GraphQL API, at https://api.newrelic.com/graphql (EU: https://api.eu.newrelic.com/graphql), following the migration guide

name: New Relic
title: New Relic: Deployments v0 API (deployments.xml) removed
summary: Effective July 31, 2027, the New Relic REST API v2 (excluding some Alerts endpoints) and the Deployments v0 API will reach end of life (EOL
replacement: changeTrackingCreateEvent mutation in NerdGraph to record deployments, and NRQL to query them

name: New Relic
title: New Relic: REST API v2 Alerts endpoints removed
summary: Effective July 31, 2027, the New Relic REST API v2 (excluding some Alerts endpoints) and the Deployments v0 API will reach end of life (EOL
replacement: NerdGraph Incident API (NrAiIncident), NerdGraph Issues API (NrAiIssue), Notifications Workflows and Destinations, and NerdGraph change tracking API; detailed guidance to follow in a supplemental announcement
